backend/main.mo: Defines product, order, and export inquiry types with maps for persistent storage and initializes a default product catalog.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries linking features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short summaries for many frontend files describing their purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Defines global CSS variables and Tailwind layers for light and dark theme styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and script loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes, initializes the product catalog, and wraps the app with theme and cart providers.
frontend/src/components/ExportInquiryFor: Form component for submitting export inquiries with validation, mutation handling, and optional inline success display.
frontend/src/components/OwnerGate.tsx: Gates owner-only content based on local owner mode state with enable/disable controls.
frontend/src/components/ProcessPicture.t: Renders a product’s process picture or a fallback placeholder, supporting thumbnail and large variants.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, category, name, price, and link to product details.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Renders the site footer with company info, links, social icons, and WhatsApp contact.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Provides the main header with navigation, WhatsApp link, cart button, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Wraps pages with a header, footer, and main content layout.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: Manages cart state with add, update, remove, and clear functions using localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refetching queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useExportInquiry.ts: Provides a mutation hook to submit export inquiries via the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity authentication, login state, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useOrders.ts: Exposes a mutation hook for placing orders and invalidating related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useOwnerContact.ts: Retrieves owner contact info and updates on storage or custom events.
frontend/src/hooks/useOwnerData.ts: Fetches all orders and export inquiries for the owner using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks for fetching products, categories, and filtered product lists from the backend.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a warm color palette with light and dark theme variables.
frontend/src/lib/cart.ts: Defines cart item structure and functions to add, update, remove items, and compute totals.
frontend/src/lib/ownerContact.ts: Manages owner contact info with validation and localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/lib/ownerMode.ts: Stores and retrieves a boolean flag for enabling owner mode via localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/processPictures.ts: Maps backend process picture filenames to generated static asset paths.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays cart items with quantity editing, removal, and order summary UI.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Handles checkout form, validates input, submits orders, and clears the cart.
frontend/src/pages/ExportInquiryPage.tsx: Shows export inquiry form and confirmation state after submission.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home landing page presenting product categories, company info, and contact options.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Displays order confirmation details, including order ID and navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/OwnerPage.tsx: Admin page showing all orders and export inquiries with tabbed navigation and detailed order dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Displays full product details, pricing, quantity selection, and add‑to‑cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Product listing page with category-based filtering and responsive product grid.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, typography, container settings, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata including schema version, feature list, known issues, and architectural notes.
